.github/workflows/quality-gates.yml.template:
name: Quality Gates P0-P4

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  p0-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build # P0: Must compile
      
  p1-typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx tsc --noEmit # P1: No type errors
      
  p2-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint # P2: Code style
      
  p3-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test # P3: Tests pass
      
  p4-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: |
          # P4: Check documentation
          test -f README.md
          test -f CHANGELOG.md

package.json.template:
{
  "scripts": {
    "build": "next build",
    "type-check": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "eslint . --ext ts,tsx --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0",
    "lint:fix": "eslint . --ext ts,tsx --fix",
    "test": "jest",
    "test:integration": "jest --testPathPattern=integration",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "quality:p0": "npm run build",
    "quality:p1": "npm run type-check",
    "quality:p2": "npm run lint",
    "quality:p3": "npm run test",
    "quality:all": "npm run quality:p0 && npm run quality:p1 && npm run quality:p2 && npm run quality:p3"
  }
}

.github/pull_request_template.md.template:
## 📋 E16 Auto-Review Checklist

### ⚠️ Risk Assessment
- [ ] **Breaking changes?** (API, DB schema, env vars)
- [ ] **Security impact?** (auth, permissions, data exposure)
- [ ] **Performance impact?** (queries, bundle size, memory)
- [ ] **Dependencies changes?** (new packages, upgrades)

### 🎯 Alternatives Considered
- [ ] **Option A**: {{alternative_1}}
- [ ] **Option B**: {{alternative_2}}
- [ ] **Chosen**: {{chosen_solution}} - **Why**: {{justification}}

### ✅ Quality Gates
- [ ] P0: Build passes
- [ ] P1: TypeScript strict
- [ ] P2: Lint/format clean
- [ ] P3: Tests pass (including new tests)
- [ ] P4: Documentation updated

### 📚 Documentation
- [ ] ADR created/updated if architectural decision
- [ ] README updated if user-facing changes
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added

### 🧪 Testing Strategy
- [ ] **Unit tests** for new logic
- [ ] **Integration tests** for API changes
- [ ] **E2E tests** for user-facing features
- [ ] **Manual testing** completed

---

{{description}}

{{test_instructions}}

scripts/pre-commit-e16.sh.template:
#!/bin/bash
# E16 Pre-commit Guards

echo "🛡️ E16 Auto-Review Guards"
echo "========================"

# Check for potential issues
EXIT_CODE=0

# 1. Check for TODO/FIXME without issue links
TODO_COUNT=$(git diff --cached --name-only | xargs grep -l "TODO\|FIXME" | wc -l)
if [ $TODO_COUNT -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "⚠️ TODO/FIXME found - Link to issues?"
  git diff --cached --name-only | xargs grep -n "TODO\|FIXME"
  read -p "Continue? (y/n) " -n 1 -r
  [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] && exit 1
fi

# 2. Check for console.log in production code
CONSOLE_COUNT=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$" | xargs grep -l "console\." | wc -l)
if [ $CONSOLE_COUNT -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "❌ console.log found in production code"
  EXIT_CODE=1
fi

# 3. Check for large files
LARGE_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | xargs ls -la | awk '$5 > 100000 {print $9" ("$5" bytes)"}')
if [ -n "$LARGE_FILES" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ Large files detected:"
  echo "$LARGE_FILES"
  read -p "Continue? (y/n) " -n 1 -r
  [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] && exit 1
fi

# 4. Quality Gates check
echo "Running Quality Gates..."
npm run quality:all || EXIT_CODE=1

if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "✅ All E16 guards passed"
else
  echo "❌ E16 guards failed - fix issues before commit"
fi

exit $EXIT_CODE
